summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit b8dd8004. The release adds Spanish and French beta interface translations, offers channel-name shortening for radio limits, resynchronizes FT-70D clone reads on the AH51G identifier, decodes Icom ID-5100 DTCS-T and pocket-beep tones, adds the TIDRADIO TD-H9 Normal/HAM/GMRS driver on the TD-H8 G4 transport, matches OEM memory-session timing for TK-863G, updates UV-5R Mini handshakes, and reuses loaded bridge drivers across reloads. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 253 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 636 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.73 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the TD-H9, UV-5RM Plus, TK-863G, and bridge updates and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.73.
